BitMine Immersion Technologies has taken another major step in the Ethereum market, announcing that its treasury has grown to 5.79 million ETH—equivalent to approximately 4.8% of Ethereum's circulating supply.
The latest increase follows another round of Ethereum purchases, bringing the company closer to its long-term goal of holding 5% of all ETH in circulation. If achieved, it would mark one of the largest corporate Ethereum treasuries ever assembled.
Beyond accumulating ETH, BitMine has also staked the majority of its holdings, allowing the company to earn staking rewards while helping secure the Ethereum network. According to its latest update, more than 4.9 million ETH is currently staked.
The announcement highlights a growing trend among publicly traded companies expanding their digital asset reserves. While Bitcoin has traditionally dominated corporate treasury strategies, Ethereum is increasingly attracting institutional attention thanks to its role in decentralized finance, tokenization, and smart contract applications.
BitMine also reported that its combined crypto holdings, cash, marketable securities, and strategic investments are now valued at approximately US$11.8 billion, underscoring the scale of its digital asset strategy.
Although the figures come from the company's own public disclosures, the announcement has drawn significant attention across the crypto industry, with many viewing it as another sign of rising institutional confidence in Ethereum.#ETH

Some people say the current FNG index is only 29, ETH has dropped 62% from its peak, its valuation is already on the floor, and it’s time to buy the dip.

I’ll ask just one thing: are you sure this isn’t mid-slope?

I’ve seen this too many times—people think the drop is already over, only to watch it get cut in half again. The real bottom has never been “it looks cheap”; it’s when it has fallen to the point where most people don’t even dare to look.

Right now, ETH is at $ 1880, down 4.3% in the past 24 hours and down 2.7% over 7 days. Selling pressure in the short term hasn’t stopped. If the level at 1828.99 can’t be held, how much further downside is there? I can’t promise anything.

But if we switch perspectives—trading volume has stayed active, which suggests someone is still actively working it, not fully giving up. BTC’s share is 56.4%, and funds are indeed concentrating toward BTC, but ETH still has a 19.4% gain over the last 30 days, which shows this one hasn’t completely fallen behind.

Will this become interesting in the future? It might. But can you really place the bet right now? I’m still observing.

Uncertainty Continues in Crypto Regulation, Clarity Act Bill Possible Delay! Here Are the Details

The Senate vote on the CLARITY Act, which is expected to establish the legal framework for the cryptocurrency market in the US, may be delayed. With the sanctions bill against Russia and high-level federal appointments taking priority on the Senate agenda, the likelihood of the CLARITY Act, which regulates the cryptocurrency market, being postponed beyond next week has significantly increased.

Recent reports highlight the traditional working methods of the US Senate, noting that the institution typically considers only one controversial bill at a time. For example, in a place like Aave where interest rates float and liquidations can happen instantly, a delay of a few hours is enough to completely decouple BTC and stablecoin prices—wiping out with huge bad debt. That’s when it clicked for me: TBV’s slow pacing was originally tailored for fixed-rate strategies. What’s the fastest way to make money in the crypto market?

Many people first think about spot DCA and burying “100x” coins. But the truth is, if you want to grow a small amount of capital quickly, rolling over positions (rolling the capital forward) is the truly effective approach.

Roll a few thousand USDT into tens of thousands, and tens of thousands into hundreds of thousands—when you catch a smooth trending market, the rate of capital expansion is truly astonishing.$BTC 

But I’ve seen too many people who make several times the profit by rolling over positions, only to give it all back to the market at the end. The core reason is simple: rolling over amplifies gains, and it also amplifies human greed.

This strategy isn’t complicated. Test with a small position first. Once the direction is correct, use unrealized profit to add to your position along the trend.

Take 1000 USDT as an example. Don’t go all-in at once. Start with a small position to probe. If the market moves smoothly, lock in part of the profit, and let the remaining funds continue competing along the trend. If you judge you’re wrong, control losses in time and wait patiently for the next opportunity$ETH 

People who can grow steadily by rolling over positions share one common trait: they know when to enter—and they also know when to stop.

Most people fail not because they can’t read the market or can’t make money, but because they can’t control their desire after they become profitable.

In a rising phase, they’re reluctant to reduce—afraid of missing out. When the market reverses, they’re unwilling to cut losses and cling to fantasies, stubbornly holding on. Just one careless mistake can wipe out all the earlier gains to zero.

To roll positions, two bottom lines must be firmly upheld: #BTC 

First, when the trend turns, exit decisively—don’t rely on luck.

Second, when profit reaches your target, prioritize extracting part of it and taking it off the table. Unrealized profit in your account doesn’t count as truly yours yet—the funds you withdraw truly belong to you.

Also remember: rolling positions isn’t suitable for every market. Only when the trend is clear and there’s sufficient volatility can this method realize its value. If you get stuck in choppy, range-bound conditions and keep operating frequently, in the end you’ll only burn money on trading fees#ETH 

When opportunities arrive, you need to seize them. When there isn’t a clear setup, wait calmly.

What rolling over really competes on isn’t bravery—it’s trading discipline and consistency.

If you act blindly, you think you’re rolling a snowball, but in the end the market will slowly swallow your principal.

币圈来钱最快的路子是什么？

很多人第一反应现货定投、埋伏百倍币。但实话讲，想要小资金快速做大，滚仓才是真正有效的方式

几千 U 滚到几万，几万做到几十万，遇上顺畅趋势，资金扩张速度十分惊人。$BTC 

可我见过太多人，靠着滚仓赚几倍利润，到头来又全部还给市场。核心原因很简单：滚仓放大收益的同时，同样放大人性的贪婪

这套玩法逻辑并不复杂。先用小仓位试错，方向走对，利用浮盈顺势加仓

拿 1000U 举例，不要一次性满仓进场，先小仓位试探。行情走顺，锁定一部分利润，剩下资金顺着趋势继续博弈；一旦判断出错，及时控制亏损，耐心等待下一次机会$ETH 

能依靠滚仓稳步做大的人，都有一个共性：懂得何时进场，更懂得何时收手

大部分人失败，不是看不懂行情、不会赚钱，而是盈利之后把控不住欲望

上涨阶段舍不得减仓，总怕踏空行情；行情反转又不愿止损，心存幻想硬扛。仅仅一次大意，前期所有收益直接清零

做滚仓，两条底线必须死守：#BTC 

第一，趋势扭转，果断离场，不抱有侥幸；

第二，利润抵达目标，优先提取部分落袋。账户浮盈不算真正到手，提现的资金才真正属于你

另外切记，滚仓不适合所有行情。只有趋势明朗、波动充足的时候，这套方法才能发挥价值。倘若陷入震荡行情频繁操作，最后只会白白损耗手续费#ETH 

机会出现敢于把握，没有行情安心等待

滚仓比拼的从来不是胆量，而是持之以恒的交易纪律

盲目操作，你以为自己在滚雪球，最后只会被市场慢慢吞噬本金

title: Як обвал в Азії та стійкість Європи сформували локаль дно на крипторинку 28.07.2026 року
subTitle:
Початок торговельної сесії 28 липня вкотре продемонстрував тісний міжринковий зв'язок між технологічним сектором США, азійськими виробниками напівпровідників та ринком цифрових активів.
Нічна хвиля продажів, яка пройшлася біржами, мала чітку макроекономічну природу й завершилася локальним зняттям ліквідності з наступним викупом.
1. Американський тригер та азійський системний шок
Усе розпочалося з корекції технологічних гігантів США в секторі Risk-On. Акції провідних розробників чипів та ШІ опинилися під тиском:
AMD: -5.17%NVIDIA: -4.99%Intel: -0.70%
Це спричинило просідання технологічного індексу NASDAQ на -0.32%, тоді як ширший ринок S&P 500 (+0.02%) утримався в режимі флету. Негативне закриття США спровокувало відтік капіталу з ризикових активів, зокрема через скорочення експозиції в спотових крипто-ETF.
Проте основний удар по ринках відбувся о 3:00 за київським часом з відкриттям Азійсько-Тихоокеанського регіону. Побоювання, що американські технологічні гіганти скорочуватимуть замовлення, викликали каскадний розпродаж акцій азійських постачальників пам'яті:
Samsung Electronics: -13.50%SK Hynix: -14.65%Південнокорейський KOSPI: обвалився майже на -11% (системний скид важелів)Японський Nikkei 225: втратив близько -4.00%Материковий Китай (CSI 300): знизився на -3.00%Гонконг (Hang Seng): утримався у відносному флеті.

Додатковим макрофактором стало зростання геополітичної напруги після заяв Дональда Трампа про готовність продовжувати військові удари по Ірану у разі відсутності компромісу, що миттєво повернуло на ринок премію за ризик.
2. Європейський імунітет: чому DAX та FTSE витримали удар
На відміну від Азії, європейські фондові майданчики відкрилися з помірним зростанням, відмовившись підтримувати загальний негативний тренд.
Причина полягає в фундаментальній структурі європейського ринку. Німецький DAX та британський FTSE 100 орієнтовані на традиційну економіку: важка та хімічна промисловість, машинобудування, енергетика та енергоносії. Частка високоризикових технологічних компаній тут мінімальна, що дозволило Європі продемонструвати стійкість під час напівпровідникового шторму в Азії.
3. Вплив на крипторинок та технічний розворот (TOTAL, BTC, ETH)
Стрімке падіння азійських індексів о 3:00 ранку спровокувало на криптобіржах каскад автоматичних ліквідацій лонг-позицій. Проте вже з відкриттям європейської сесії ринок знайшов підтримку й розпочав локальне відновлення.
Динаміка капіталізації (1-годинні графіки):
TOTAL (Загальна капіталізація): після просідання до дна $2.14T – $2.15T відновилася до $2.16T.TOTAL2 (Без BTC): відштовхнулася від лоу $877.5B і піднялася до $880.8B.TOTAL3 (Альтернативні монети без BTC та ETH): стабілізувалася на рівні $653.3B після зниження до $652.1B.

Поведінка провідних активів та індикаторів:
Bitcoin (BTC): відштовхнувся від локального дна $63,072 і торгується в районі $63,562.Ethereum (ETH): після протесту зони підтримки $1,866 відновився до $1,885.Осцилятори (VMC Cipher B): на 1-годинних таймфреймах розвернулися з глибокої зони перепроданості, сформувавши побудову вихідного імпульсу та підтверджуючи зміну локального напрямку руху.
Нічний розпродаж на крипторинку став результатом міжринкового ланцюжка від США до Азії. Однак відсутність паніки на біржових майданчиках Європи та технічна перепроданість дозволили цифровим активам зафіксувати локальне дно. Найближчими годинами вирішальним фактором для утримання цього відскоку стане відкриття американських бірж та здатність інвесторів у США викупити просідання в технологічному секторі.

📰 Ukraine launches a massive drone attack straight at Moscow! Will BTC $63,500 hold up?

Event Overview

Before Trump met with Zelensky and before the meeting even took place, Ukraine went straight for a big move—launching a large-scale drone attack on Moscow. To put it plainly, this isn’t just a simple military operation; it’s more like Zelensky adding leverage at the negotiating table. Think about it: this kind of operation is like lighting a fire in front of the old man in the room—rather than expanding diplomatic maneuvering space, it actually compresses it. Markets fear uncertainty the most. Once this happens, risk-aversion sentiment spikes immediately.

In-Depth Analysis

Why is this news important?

Guys, here’s a key truth: the crypto market is never isolated. When geopolitical conflict escalates, the first reaction is always capital flowing into safer assets. BTC may be widely called “digital gold,” but when panic hits, its behavior looks more like a Nasdaq-style risk asset than real gold.

The timing of this drone attack is extremely delicate—right before Trump and Zelensky meet. Zelensky wants to prove Ukraine still has the capability to retaliate, and he doesn’t want to be in a weak position at the negotiating table. translatedData.content:
#ETH ETH in my eyes is just a junk asset—and one of the crypto ecosystems I’ve seen that’s most skilled at turning newly added liquidity into an exit window.

This doesn’t mean Ethereum has no technical value. It’s that an asset like ETH is extremely unfriendly to secondary-market investors.

I backtested the same trend-following strategy. Even though ETH’s entire history ultimately produced profits, its maximum drawdown reached 80%. Even if I only look at the period after spot ETF approvals, the maximum drawdown is still 55%. As the #2 asset in crypto, this result isn’t just ordinary volatility—it points to a structural problem in the quality of the trend.

Every time ETH rises to a high level and is preparing to break out of its trading range, the market has just managed to gather the chasing capital and trading depth. Then a large amount of low-cost holdings that usually don’t participate in trading enter the market. The Foundation, ecosystem treasuries, early holders, and staking rewards don’t need to buy their way into the secondary market to obtain those coins; they can cash out at market prices when investors provide liquidity.

The Ethereum Foundation has even made this explicit in its fiscal policy: it will regularly calculate and sell ETH based on operational funding needs. While this can be perfectly legal, the outcome is no different for later investors—your buy orders become an exit channel for existing supply.

So-called “120 million ETH times $1,800” is only a uniform price label applied to all outstanding supply using a small amount of marginal trades. It doesn’t mean all ETH has actually been exchanged at $1,800, and it doesn’t mean those coins can all be redeemed simultaneously at $1,800.

After BTC falls, it can still form a new price center in the next cycle. ETH, however, has long been repeatedly oscillating around the large box range that began in 2022. Each breakout looks like the start of a bull market, but is then crushed back down by suddenly expanded potential supply.

So my conclusion is very simple:

The high-level entrapment in ETH isn’t an accident—it’s the natural outcome of its supply structure. The added demand first serves the monetization needs of early, low-cost holders—not later investors.

It might be a valuable blockchain, but that doesn’t mean ETH is an investor-friendly asset. The technology belongs to the ecosystem, the selling pressure belongs to those holding the coins—and ultimately, it’s always the secondary-market buyers who bear the drawdowns.

Original text from the Foundation’s fiscal policy:
https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/06/04/ef-treasury-policy

content:
#ETH ETH在我眼里就是垃圾资产，也是我见过最擅长把新增流动性变成退出窗口的加密生态之一。

这不是说以太坊的技术没有价值，而是ETH这种资产对二级市场投资者极不友好。

我用同一套趋势策略回测：ETH全历史最终虽然盈利，最大回撤却达到80%；即使只统计现货ETF批准后的阶段，最大回撤仍有55%。作为加密货币第二大资产，这种结果不是普通波动，而是趋势质量存在结构性问题。

ETH每次上涨到高位、准备突破箱体时，市场刚刚聚集起追涨资金和成交深度，大量平时不参与交易的低成本筹码就会进入市场。基金会、生态金库、早期持有者和质押收益并不需要通过二级市场买入获得筹码，却可以在投资者提供流动性时按市场价格兑现。

Ethereum Foundation甚至已经在财政政策中明确：会根据运营资金需求，定期计算并出售ETH。这个行为当然可以完全合法，但对后来投资者而言，结果没有区别——你的买盘成为了存量筹码的退出通道。

所谓1.2亿枚ETH乘以1800美元，只是用少量边际成交给全部存量筹码统一标价。它不代表所有ETH都经历过1800美元的真实换手，更不代表这些筹码能够同时按1800美元兑现。

BTC下跌之后还能在下一轮周期形成新的价格中枢；ETH却长期围绕2022年以来的大箱体反复横跳。每次突破都像牛市开始，随后又被突然扩张的潜在供给砸回去。

所以我的结论很简单：

ETH的高位套牢不是偶然事故，而是其供给结构的自然结果。新增需求首先服务的不是后来投资者，而是早期低成本筹码的变现需求。

它可能是一条有价值的区块链，但不等于ETH是一项对投资者友好的资产。技术属于生态，卖压属于持币者，最后承担回撤的永远是二级市场接盘者。

基金会财政政策原文：
https://blog.ethereum.org/2025/06/04/ef-treasury-policy

Event Overview

To put it simply, this is one thing: Israel’s Prime Minister Netanyahu is going to the White House to personally hand Trump a set of "evidence materials" regarding Iran’s nuclear program. This isn’t a normal diplomatic visit—it’s clearly meant to pull the U.S. back onto a tougher posture toward Iran. The news hit, and the market has already started voting with its feet—BTC fell to $63,612, down 2.79% in 24 hours. ETH is even worse: $1,887.13, directly dropping 4.2%.

In-Depth Analysis

Why is this news important?

Honestly, the key here isn’t whether Iran actually has nuclear weapons—it’s that Netanyahu chose this moment to "deliver a blade" at the White House.

First layer logic: Israel has consistently tried to shape Iran’s "threat narrative." Every time tensions in the Middle East ease even slightly, Israel brings out new intelligence to reignite the fire. This time, Netanyahu directly runs to present it at the White House at full strength, which suggests he believes this Trump window is worth betting on.

Second layer logic: Trump’s stance toward Iran is far tougher than Biden’s. In 2018, it was him who unilaterally tore up the Iran nuclear deal. Now Netanyahu brings "nuclear evidence"—it’s like handing Trump a perfect policy lever. If the U.S. accepts this narrative, the diplomatic channel between the U.S. and Iran could basically be zeroed out, and new rounds of sanctions—or even military pressure—may be back on the table.

Third layer: From the crypto market perspective, geopolitical conflict is the biggest emotional bomb. In April 2024, when Iran and Israel traded missile greetings, BTC plunged from the $67,000 range to around $60,000 within days. This time, it hasn’t reached the point of actual action yet, but what the market fears most is uncertainty—capital tends to run first to avoid risk.

Impact on the Market

In the short term, the downside is already written all over it. When BTC breaks below the $63,612 level, it shows the long side’s defenses are starting to loosen. ETH’s 4.2% drop reflects even more clearly that in-market funds are accelerating their withdrawal—retail traders may sell ETH first to protect BTC, but in the end, they often can’t protect both.

For the mid-term outlook, watch three signals: First, whether Trump issues a tough statement after the meeting; second, whether Iran responds intensely; third, how U.S. stocks and gold perform. If all three signals point toward an "escalation of conflict," BTC could test the $60,000 integer level, and it’s not impossible for ETH to break below $1,800.

Historical reference is very clear: whenever something big happens in the Middle East, the crypto market tends to drop first—but the speed of rebounds has also been increasing. The difference this time is that Netanyahu isn’t simply manufacturing conflict—he’s trying to change the direction of America’s Iran policy. Political games at this level aren’t something the market can fully digest within just a couple of days.

Bottom line: the money in the market is already voting with its feet. BTC at $63,612 and ETH at $1,887.13 are the answer.

Trading Ideas

📰 内塔尼亚胡带着伊朗核证据去见特朗普！BTC $63,612悬了

事件概述

说白了就一件事：以色列总理内塔尼亚胡要去白宫，当面给特朗普交一份关于伊朗核计划的"证据材料"。这玩意儿不是普通的外交拜访，摆明了是想把美国拉回对伊强硬路线。消息一出，市场已经开始用脚投票——BTC跌到$63,612，24小时砸了2.79%，ETH更惨，$1,887.13，直接跌掉4.2%。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

讲真，这事的核心不是伊朗到底有没有搞核武器，而是内塔尼亚胡选在这个节点去白宫"递刀子"。

第一层逻辑：以色列一直在试图塑造伊朗的"威胁叙事"。每次中东局势稍微缓和，以方就会拿出新情报把火重新点着。这次直接跑到白宫面呈，级别拉满了，说明内塔尼亚胡认为特朗普这个窗口期值得押注。

第二层逻辑：特朗普本身对伊朗的态度就比拜登硬得多。2018年单方面撕毁伊核协议的人就是他。现在内塔尼亚胡拿着"核证据"来，等于给特朗普送了个完美的政策抓手——如果美方接受这套叙事，美伊外交通道基本归零，新一轮制裁甚至军事施压都可能上桌。

第三层：从币圈角度看，地缘冲突是最大的情绪炸弹。2024年4月伊朗和以色列互相导弹问候的时候，BTC几天内从$67,000区间跳水到$60,000附近。这次虽然还没到动手的地步，但市场最怕的就是不确定性——资金会先跑为敬。

对市场的影响

短期来看，利空已经写在脸上了。BTC跌破$63,612这个位置，说明多头防线开始松动。ETH跌4.2%更是反映出场内资金在加速撤退——散户先抛ETH保BTC，但最后往往两个都保不住。

中期推演要看三个信号：第一，特朗普会后发不发强硬声明；第二，伊朗方面有没有激烈回应；第三，美股和黄金怎么走。如果三个信号都往"冲突升级"方向走，BTC可能考验$60,000整数关口，ETH破$1,800不是不可能。

历史参考很明确：中东每出一次大事，加密市场就先跌为敬，但反弹速度也在加快。问题在于这次跟之前不一样的地方是——内塔尼亚胡不是在制造冲突，他是在试图改变美国的对伊政策走向。这个级别的政治博弈，影响周期不是一两天能消化的。

说白了，现在场内的钱已经在用脚投票了，$63,612的BTC和$1,887.13的ETH就是答案。

操作思路

🎯 影响预判
- 币种：BTC / ETH
- 方向：利空📉 预测跌
- 时长：BTC 12小时 / ETH 24小时

💡 别急着抄底。这事的发酵才刚开始，白宫会面还没发生呢，真正的大波动在会后。BTC如果守住$63,612附近震荡，说明市场在等消息；一旦放量跌破$62,000，那就是恐慌盘出来了，到时候再考虑接不接。ETH的$1,800是心理关口，破了会有一波加速下行。现在最好的操作就是管住手，别做左侧。

ETH is now at 1879. Three days ago it was at 1982—it's down by almost a hundred points. All that was just wasted gains.

Earlier, every post said that it was thin order book and would hard-pull it up. Now the order book is thick, yet it still drops. Every time I think I finally understand it, it does the opposite. Now that I understand, the money is already gone.

What’s interesting is that the number of on-chain borrowers has dropped by 70%. People who borrowed 12 hours ago are now up to 50% more—but now everyone is repaying. Those who went long at the bottom using up to 12x and more shorts can’t hold on; they’re cutting losses and paying their debts. Spot has had over 90,000 units withdrawn in three hours. In the past 36 hours there has been zero net inflow—there isn’t a single positive flow.

Futures too: active sell orders are more than double active buy orders, open interest is falling, and the basis has turned negative. The longs are running. Sentiment has already changed.

But the price is stuck between 1865 and 1880. The bids in the order book are stacked up—three times thicker than the asks. With sell pressure that strong, it still can’t be pushed down; someone keeps catching it.

Whale accounts have increased by 11%, but their positions are actually being reduced further on the long side. They’re bringing people in while they themselves are cutting—that logic really baffles me.

Are they accumulating quietly, or propping things up to distribute? I can’t tell. When I can’t read the market, I don’t touch it—that’s an experience bought with losses.

ETH现在1879，三天前还在1982，跌了快一百个点，全是白涨的。

之前每帖说它盘口薄硬拉，现在盘口厚了还是掉。我每次以为看懂了，它就反着来。现在看懂了，钱已经没了。

有意思的是链上借钱的人少了七成。十二个小时前借钱的人还多了五成，现在全在还钱。那些12倍多空比借钱抄底的扛不住了，在割肉还债。现货三小时跑了九万多个出来，三十六小时零根净流入，一根正的都没有。

合约也是，主动卖单比买单多一倍，持仓量在掉，基差都转负了。多头在跑路，情绪已经变了。

但价格就卡在1865-1880，盘口买盘堆得比卖单厚三倍。卖压这么猛都砸不下去，有人一直在接。

鲸鱼开户多了11%，但仓位反而在减多。一边拉人进来，一边自己在减，真是搞不明白这逻辑。

到底是在吸筹还是在托底出货，我搞不明白。看不懂的行情不碰，这是亏出来的经验。

📰 Crypto Market Hotspot Delivery

1. Risk-premium reversal in the crude oil market; whale short positions show clear floating profits
WTI crude oil continues to fall, with prices pressing near the $80 level. Compared with the recent high, it has dropped significantly. Expectations that geopolitical tensions will ease and energy transportation will resume have warmed, driving oil prices to further squeeze out the risk premium that built up earlier. The previous crude oil short whale on Hyperliquid holds about 171,900 CL short contracts, with current unrealized profit of approximately $1.83 million, indicating that capital is betting on the short-term continuation of the pullback.

2. Semiconductor sector under pressure; concerns in the debt market are rising
In recent days, semiconductor-related assets have seen pullbacks. Behind this, besides valuation pressure, worries in the debt market about credit risk for large technology customers are also increasing. CDS prices for entities such as Oracle, SpaceX, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Broadcom have recently risen to new highs. The market has begun to fear that Nvidia’s business model could extend to financing or providing guarantees for customers, thereby amplifying the industry’s risk exposure.

3. Fed officials take a more hawkish stance; inflation remains the core focus
Multiple Fed officials have recently made concentrated comments, and the overall tone is hawkish. Most officials believe inflation remains above target, with monetary policy in a neutral-to-slightly-tight or mildly restrictive zone. If core inflation continues to climb, the next steps may still include further tightening. Pricing for the probability of near-term rate hikes has increased somewhat, showing that investors are starting to reassess the interest-rate path.

4. High oil prices may further intensify inflation pressure; the market bets on a tougher policy
Some institutions believe that U.S. inflation and the labor market still show resilience. Coupled with recent oil-price volatility, this may further reinforce the Fed’s tightening inclination. However, most officials also emphasize that until the transmission of inflation becomes clearer, policymakers may first observe how persistent the oil-price shock is. Overall, market expectations for the interest-rate path in the coming months are gradually shifting toward cautious-to-tighter.

5. Liquidations in the crypto market expand; leveraged funds face another shock
Over the past 24 hours, liquidation losses across the entire network reached $250 million, indicating that market volatility is still continuing to release leveraged risk. BTC and ETH are the main liquidated assets, and SOL and XRP have also seen clear liquidations. Market sentiment remains relatively cautious. If macro risks and risk-asset pullbacks develop in parallel, volatility on the derivatives side could continue to be amplified.

#BTC #ETH #Crypto Market

2. 半导体板块承压，债务市场担忧升温
近期半导体相关资产出现回调，背后除了估值压力外，债务市场对大型科技客户信用风险的担忧也在升温。甲骨文、SpaceX、Alphabet、亚马逊、Meta、博通等主体的 CDS 价格近期升至新高，市场开始担心英伟达的商业模式可能延伸至为客户融资或担保，从而放大行业风险敞口。

3. 美联储官员立场偏鹰，通胀仍是核心焦点
多位美联储官员近期密集表态，整体语气偏鹰。多数官员认为通胀仍高于目标，货币政策处于中性偏紧或温和限制区间，若核心通胀持续走高，后续仍可能考虑进一步收紧。市场对短期加息概率的定价有所升温，显示投资者开始重新评估利率路径。

4. 高油价或加剧通胀压力，市场押注更强硬政策
部分机构观点认为，美国通胀与劳动力市场仍具韧性，叠加近期油价波动，可能进一步强化美联储的紧缩倾向。不过，多数官员也强调，在通胀传导更加明确前，政策层面可能先观察油价冲击的持续性。整体看，市场对未来数月利率路径的预期正逐步转向谨慎偏紧。

Yesterday, the moment I saw ETH break below $ 1890, it suddenly reminded me of the expression I had before the peak of the 2021 bull market—holding positions, staring at the screen, and thinking to myself: Should I run? 

In the end, I didn’t run. And then there was no “then.”

Seriously, the market signals right now are very confusing. In the past 24 hours it’s down 3.6%, and trading volume suddenly surged—almost reaching 5% of market cap. This volume isn’t something retail can smash out—either someone is dumping hard, or institutions are accumulating. The Fear & Greed Index is stuck at 29. The whole market feels like it’s been given a sedative: no panic, no excitement.

I’ve been watching that support level at $ 1828 for a long time. If it breaks, the next level below is $ 1700; if it holds, we’ll test resistance at $ 2013. Honestly, that range isn’t that big—but in a market like this, staying put is safer than randomly moving.

My take? I’m not as certain as you might think. But three signals make me lean upward: first, it’s down 62% from overextended levels, and the valuation really is low; second, FNG is stuck at 29 and won’t budge—suggesting the bulls aren’t completely dead; third, a surge in volume isn’t necessarily bad—old hands know this: volume up that doesn’t go down is what’s worth watching.

Are you itching to trade? Of course it’s itchy. But the lesson from 2021 tells me: say “all in” with your mouth, but keep your hands steady. This time, I didn’t jump in—I’m just watching.

I spent some time looking beyond market charts recently because it feels like the crypto conversation is slowly becoming less about launching new blockchains and more about improving the foundations that existing networks rely on. That shift is what led me to Babylon (BABY). What caught my attention was not the idea of adding another ecosystem, but the possibility of allowing Bitcoin to contribute to the security of Proof-of-Stake chains while remaining on its own network through self-custodial staking. I started thinking about how much trust and value Bitcoin has accumulated over the years, yet most of that security has remained isolated from the rest of the blockchain landscape. What interests me is that Babylon seems to explore whether that security can be shared without changing Bitcoin's underlying principles. Still, I wonder if the model can remain practical as more networks, validators, and participants become involved, since increasing complexity often introduces new risks. Strong technical architecture is important, but adoption, reliability, and consistent performance over time matter just as much. I don't see Babylon as a finished solution, and perhaps that's what makes it worth following. Previously, each post said that the order book was thin, yet it still got hard-pulled. Now the order book is thick, with buy-side orders stacked up—but it still drops. Every time I think I finally understand it, it goes the other way. Now that I really do understand it, the money is already gone.

Over the past three days, large orders leaving totaled more than thirty thousand, yet on the plaza, over four hundred KOLs are still shouting for a breakout. They all say it’s bullish and strong-and-long; no one says otherwise. Where are the shills now? Why aren’t they calling for it anymore?

The number of people borrowing on-chain is down by more than 70%. Those who borrowed earlier to buy the bottom have been repaying and running. Taker-initiated buy orders have actually increased by almost double, but the price still can’t move up—meaning someone is pressing it from above, taking one sell wall after another, and after taking them they keep smashing.

The reason the sell orders stack is smaller now isn’t that the buy side is stronger—it’s that nobody dares to place sell orders. With the little thickness in the order book, once it’s hit it goes straight through; it can’t hold at all. I don’t believe it can V-reverse directly from here. Let the spot market run out enough first, then we’ll talk.

As the rate decision and key economic data approach, the crypto market is in a heightened sensitivity period for macro news. 6. SpaceX估值讨论升温，带动加密风险资产联想

#baby Those who have been around the circle for a while all know that BTC (the “Big Biscuit”) is the most closed-off fortress. In the past, if you wanted the Bitcoin in your hands to generate returns in other ecosystems, you had to pull off cross-chain mapping. After all that trouble, you effectively handed over your asset’s lifeline to someone else—far from reassuring.

@babylonlabs_io This time, they came up with a new twist: why not do asset transfers at all—just “borrow their prestige.” Your coins don’t move; they just sit steadily in the mainnet address. Using their remote staking code, other PoS chains can directly account for that asset. title: Crypto Market Analysis Today: Why BTC, ETH & BNB Are at an Important Turning Point
subTitle:
The crypto market feels cautious today, but I don't think this is simply another quiet trading session. What stands out is that Bitcoin, Ethereum, and BNB are responding to a combination of macroeconomic uncertainty, liquidity conditions, and technical positioning rather than project-specific news. That usually creates a market where patience matters more than chasing momentum.
Bitcoin ($BTC) continues to trade around an important support zone after several attempts to reclaim higher levels. Buyers are still defending key price areas, yet each rally faces resistance as traders wait for greater clarity on upcoming macroeconomic events. Market participants remain focused on interest-rate expectations and global liquidity because these factors have increasingly influenced digital assets over the past year.
Ethereum ($ETH) has shown relative resilience during recent sessions. While price volatility remains elevated, ETH has occasionally outperformed Bitcoin during short-term recoveries. That relative strength suggests capital is still willing to rotate into assets with strong network activity whenever overall market sentiment improves. However, Ethereum still needs sustained buying pressure to confirm that recent strength is more than a temporary bounce.
BNB presents a different picture. Instead of experiencing the largest price swings, it has generally traded within a comparatively stable range. This stability often reflects its position inside one of the largest blockchain ecosystems, where trading activity, decentralized applications, and ecosystem usage provide ongoing demand. Even so, BNB is not isolated from broader market sentiment. When Bitcoin weakens significantly, most major assets—including BNB—still experience selling pressure.
One of today's most interesting observations is leverage. Recent market volatility has triggered liquidations across derivatives markets, reminding traders how quickly excessive leverage can amplify both gains and losses. These events frequently reset funding conditions and remove speculative positions before healthier trends emerge. In my view, monitoring derivatives activity is becoming just as important as watching spot prices.
Another factor worth following is Bitcoin dominance. Although BTC continues to attract defensive capital during uncertain periods, Ethereum has recently demonstrated moments of relative outperformance. If this trend continues alongside improving market liquidity, selective capital rotation into high-quality altcoins could become more visible. That doesn't automatically signal an "altcoin season," but it does suggest investors are becoming more selective instead of buying the entire market indiscriminately.
Macroeconomic developments remain the largest external influence. Investors are closely watching central bank policy expectations, inflation trends, bond yields, and overall risk appetite. Crypto has matured enough that it now reacts alongside traditional financial markets during periods of uncertainty. Strong fundamentals can support long-term confidence, but short-term volatility is still heavily shaped by liquidity conditions.
On-chain behavior also deserves attention. Long-term holders continue to show relatively stable conviction despite recent market swings, while exchange reserve trends and transaction activity remain useful indicators of underlying demand. These metrics rarely predict daily price movements, but they often provide valuable context about whether market participants are accumulating, distributing, or simply waiting for clearer direction.
For traders, the current environment rewards discipline more than aggressive speculation. Chasing every breakout during uncertain macro conditions can quickly lead to unnecessary losses. Waiting for confirmation, respecting risk management, and paying attention to volume, liquidity, and market structure generally produces better decisions than reacting to social media excitement.
My takeaway is straightforward: today's market is being shaped less by hype and more by macroeconomics, institutional positioning, and structural liquidity. Bitcoin remains the market's anchor, Ethereum continues to compete through network strength, and BNB benefits from ecosystem stability. Whether the next major move is higher or lower, the strongest advantage comes from understanding why capital is moving—not simply where prices happen to be today.

Event Overview

Israel has publicly warned that it will carry out “full-scale retaliation” against Iran, igniting an already volatile Middle East situation. The moment the news broke, risk assets were hit across the board. In 24 hours, BTC fell 3.11%, while ETH was hit even harder, dropping 4.64%. In plain terms, two regional powers may be about to fight for real—so global capital immediately shifts toward safe havens. The crypto market is hit first.

In-Depth Analysis

Why is this news important?

Honestly, Middle East developments are never isolated events. Israel’s tough talk this time isn’t just rhetoric—it signals preparations for actual military action. The key issue is that Iran isn’t a small player. If the fighting starts, it won’t be over in just a few days.

The logic is simple: geopolitical conflict → risk assets sold off → liquidity tightens → market sentiment collapses. We’ve seen this path repeatedly, from the Russia-Ukraine war to the Israel-Palestine conflict. Whenever great powers escalate, the first instinct is “sell everything that can be sold.” In those moments, BTC and ETH have extremely high correlation with the Nasdaq, so they can’t be treated as “digital gold.”

What’s even more troublesome is the timing. The crypto market is already in a weak, range-bound consolidation right now. BTC is hovering around $63,318 without new incremental capital flowing in. At times like this, an external black swan leaves defenses extremely thin. ETH is even worse—it has fallen to $1,875 and can’t even hold $1,900 anymore. Confidence is fragile to the extreme.

Regulators also need to be on alert. Every time there’s a big wave of volatility, regulators get handed a “ready-made excuse”:
“Look, crypto market volatility is too high—we need stricter controls.” That talking point has been prepared in advance.

Impact on the Market

In the short term, this shock isn’t over yet. If Israel truly takes action, BTC’s support levels below will be dangerous. $60,000 is a psychological line—once it breaks, it could trigger a chain reaction of liquidations. That scenario is hard to even imagine.

ETH is in an even more awkward position: its performance is already weaker than the broader market. With $1,875 just a step away from the prior low, if panic continues to spread, ETH’s downside will very likely exceed BTC’s—because altcoin “beta” gets amplified during fear.

Looking back at history: in April 2024, when Iran directly launched missiles at Israel, BTC dropped nearly 8% in the short term, but within a week it regained the lost ground. Will history repeat itself this time? It depends on whether both sides truly fight or just try to scare each other. But one thing is certain: regardless of the outcome, volatility will spike.

From a medium-term perspective, if the conflict keeps escalating, the market could enter a longer period of slow, bearish drift. Capital would likely favor stablecoins and cash more.

以色列公开喊话要对伊朗搞"全力报复"，中东火药桶直接点燃。消息一出，风险资产集体跳水，BTC 24小时跌了3.11%，ETH更惨直接-4.64%。说白了就是两个地区大国可能要真刀真枪干了，全球资金第一时间往避险方向跑，加密市场首当其冲被砸。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

讲真，中东局势从来不是孤立事件。以色列这波放狠话不是嘴炮，是实打实在准备军事行动的信号。问题在于——伊朗不是小角色，真打起来不是几天能收场的。

根本逻辑很简单：地缘冲突 → 风险资产遭抛售 → 流动性收紧 → 市场情绪崩坏。这条路我们从俄乌战争、巴以冲突反复走过。每次大国对峙升级，第一反应就是"卖掉一切能卖的东西"，BTC和ETH在这种时刻跟纳指相关性极高，完全没法当数字黄金用。

更麻烦的是时间节点。现在币圈本身就在弱势震荡，BTC在$63,318这个位置晃悠，没有增量资金进场。这种时候外部来个黑天鹅，防御力量极其薄弱。ETH更是跌到$1,875，连$1,900都保不住了，信心脆弱到极点。

监管层面也要警惕。每次大波动都会给监管机构递刀子，"你看加密市场波动太大需要更严格管控"这套话术早就准备好了。

对市场的影响

短期看，这波冲击还没完。以色列真动手的话，BTC下方支撑位会很危险。$60,000是心理关口，一旦破了会触发连环爆仓，那画面不敢想。

ETH更尴尬，本来走势就弱于大盘，$1,875离前低近在咫尺。如果恐慌继续蔓延，ETH跌幅大概率超过BTC，毕竟山寨属性在恐慌中会被放大。

参考历史，2024年4月伊朗直接对以色列发射导弹那次，BTC短期砸了快8%，但一周内就收复了失地。这次会不会重演？得看双方是真打还是互相吓唬。但有一点很确定——无论结果如何，波动率会飙升。

中期来看，如果冲突升级持续，市场可能进入一段较长的阴跌期，资金会更偏好稳定币和现金。

Old-school bank Barclays announced it plans to pour several hundred million dollars into AI systems. The goal is very clear: use artificial intelligence to reshape operational efficiency and compliance frameworks. Put simply, they’re using machines to replace people, cutting costs and improving efficiency. While BTC and ETH are still falling today, this kind of news from traditional finance accelerating into tech growth stocks provides support for overall sentiment. BTC is currently at $63,364.01, down 2.87% over the past 24 hours; ETH is even worse at $1,876.3, down 4.47%. The broader market is green, but traditional institutions are still spending on tech—showing that the smart money hasn’t stopped.

One sentence to make it clear
Barclays is betting hundreds of millions on AI; traditional finance is accelerating the tech transformation, indirectly benefiting crypto market sentiment.

What’s going on
To be honest, Barclays’ move this time is quite bold. They’re investing hundreds of millions into AI systems—not just building a chatbot. Their core demands are twofold: (1) improve operational efficiency—i.e., cut costs and speed things up; (2) handle compliance. The financial industry’s biggest headache is regulation, and AI can be used for risk control and compliance screening, saving a lot of manpower and legal expenses.

This investment sends a signal: traditional finance is no longer treating AI as a buzzword to hype—it’s actually putting real money behind it. Once Barclays runs this playbook successfully, other banks will likely follow. This kind of “tech integration” demonstration effect is a positive stimulus for the entire tech sector. Crypto has always been closely linked to tech stocks—price action in chip giants like NVDA and TSM tends to track BTC—so it’s definitely worth paying attention.

Market impact
In the short term, this news is a sentiment tailwind for the crypto market. As Barclays ramps up AI, the market will think: if even traditional banks are increasing tech spending, then tech stock fundamentals likely haven’t deteriorated. If chip stocks stabilize as a result, BTC and ETH will have more confidence to stop the fall. With panic sentiment spreading across the broader market, Barclays’ announcement feels like a calming shot.

In the medium term, if traditional finance fully embraces AI, demand for compute power and high-performance computing will keep growing. That could be a potential narrative shift opportunity for mining companies. For RIOT, MARA, and other miners—if they can sell compute capacity to AI companies, the valuation logic changes. Plus, Barclays using AI for compliance sets a precedent; in the future, regulators’ stance toward crypto AI projects may become more practical rather than simply suppressive.

My take
Guys, to be frank, the current chart looks pretty ugly—ETH is falling even harder than BTC. But the Barclays news makes me feel we shouldn’t overreact with panic. Traditional institutions are still pouring money into tech; the tech story hasn’t broken. As long as the tech thesis holds, BTC won’t sink too deeply.

I stared at Babylon’s confiscation clause for half an hour without daring to hit confirm.

To be honest, I ran the Babylon testnet twice, but if the mainnet really requires me to stake real BTC, my hands start to shake.

My understanding is that the native staking associated with @babylonlabs_io  really is awesome: the private key stays untouched, BTC is locked on the mainnet, and only the voting power is delegated out. That’s a hundred times safer than those cross-chain bridges. But I’m thinking the real risk isn’t whether it’s cross-chain or not—it’s in the confiscation.

I read the official documentation. If a validator signs twice or goes offline, the staked BTC gets deducted directly. The percentage isn’t set in stone, but the meaning is very clear: the nodes you choose aren’t reliable, so you’ll lose along with them. And that’s what’s so annoying—how am I supposed to know which node is reliable? There are a bunch of English names in the node list, some of which haven’t even polished their official website. I can’t possibly check each one’s historical block production rate, right? #ETH 

I feel like it’s just like picking a partner—everything looks fine on the surface, but only living through it tells you what they’re really like. Babylon gives you a choice, but it doesn’t give you a tool to “easily judge who’s reliable.” I’m stuck right now: do I choose the node with higher commission but a stronger background, or the one with lower commission but newer? The former hurts my wallet; the latter makes me nervous. #BTC 

There’s another thing that really bugs me: unbonding has to wait for several hundred BTC blocks—about a day or two. What if the market crashes hard? I’ll be watching my staked BTC locked up and unable to get out—I’d be frantic. Although they say you can unbond early, you can only withdraw everything at once; you can’t withdraw just half. That basically forces you to make a decision—you can’t hesitate.

So my current view is: on the mainnet, I’ll start by staking 0.1 BTC as a test. If I lose, I won’t be heartbroken. Once I run through it successfully, I’ll add slowly. I don’t believe those KOLs calling for a “blind rush.” Even with great cryptography, it still can’t fully protect against human mistakes. We small retail folks—keeping the principal safe matters more than anything. @babylonlabs_io #baby $BTC $BABY

title: Independent Thinking Is an Investor's Quiet Advantage.
subTitle:
Markets are full of opinions. Every day, someone says: Buy now. Sell now. This is the next big opportunity. Listening to different perspectives is valuable. But blindly following them is risky.
Experienced investors don't ignore advice.
They evaluate it. They compare it with their own research. They ask difficult questions. And they make decisions they can explain with confidence. Independent thinking doesn't mean believing you're always right. It means taking responsibility for your own decisions.
🔑 Key Takeaway: The strongest conviction is built on understanding, not on following the crowd.
🧠 Practical Reflection: Before acting on someone else's opinion, ask yourself: "If this advice turns out to be wrong, do I understand why I made the decision?" If the answer is yes, you're investing with ownership rather than dependence. Over time, that mindset becomes one of your greatest strengths.
Systems over emotion. Conviction over noise.#bnb #btc #eth #sol #xlm

Why do most people still not make much money during a bull market?

Many people think it’s normal to lose money in a bear market.

But what really surprised me is that after each bull market ends, there are still a large number of investors who haven’t made any money.

The problem is often not that you picked the wrong coin—it’s that you’re beaten by your trading habits.

Up 5%—afraid of giving back profits, you sell immediately;

Down 5%—worried the selloff will continue, you rush to cut losses;

Seeing others double—can’t resist chasing the price;

Just bought, the price dips, and you start to doubt your judgment.

In the end, you keep catching bids at high prices and exiting at low prices, handing your holdings to people with more patience.

The market never rewards emotional trading; it tends to reward those who have a plan and discipline.

What truly determines your returns isn’t necessarily what coin you bought, but:

* Whether you set a trading plan in advance;
* Whether you can strictly follow take-profit and stop-loss rules;
* Whether you can stay calm when the market is violently volatile.

Making money in a bull market depends on opportunities, and keeping your profits depends on discipline.#ETH $ETH

#baby $BABY A couple of days ago I was just idly scrolling through my phone when my old friend Dong sent me a Babylon security review report. He joked, “Have you actually looked through the underlying design of this project? Eight core components are shoved together in a way that looks really awkward.” When I scrolled down to the long list Zellic laid out, I honestly went silent. @babylonlabs_io 

This chain has pretty ambitious goals. Under the banner of a “Bitcoin security network,” it internally hard-wires more than twenty separate modules—BTC staking, state confirmations, IBC cross-chain transfers, reward distribution, epoch transitions, and more. Just looking at the layered “puzzle” approach, it really does match today’s tech hotspots.

But once you peel back the logic that calls into one another, the water runs extremely deep. The Zellic team spent three months doing due diligence and directly found 32 security holes (including 7 that are critical and 3 that are high risk). Even the auditing firm explicitly stated in the report that they weren’t confident they’d cleared every single mine. You have to remember: OpenZeppelin previously also ran into issues—blind spots related to proxy accounting and dodging penalty mechanisms. In such a sprawling code network, the undisclosed blind spots are probably even more frightening.

What’s most terrifying is that kind of “chain-reaction” disaster where everything shatters the moment you poke it. In theory, modularization is supposed to isolate dangers—but its cycles and confirmation components keep “visiting” each other via the underlying data. Sometimes, sending nothing more than a routine instruction to modify a validator-node list can trigger system-level errors, causing the entire network to grind to a halt instantly. Even the peripheral components responsible for minting—once they interface with the outside world—could have the number of rewards issued manually tampered with. One tiny gap can pierce the defenses of the whole chain.

Packing tons of extremely complex consensus logic together looks, on the surface, like you’re reducing dimensionality. In reality, you’re endlessly expanding the attack surface. The taller the code stack, the harder it is to discover the voids at the bottom. This isn’t a firewall at all—it’s basically force-binding risk together.

Just my personal thoughts, not investment advice. Do you all think this “stacking blocks” approach is credible? Drop your comments. #eth $ETH

这条链野心挺大。顶着“比特币安全网”的招牌，内部硬塞了BTC质押、状态确认、IBC跨链、收益发放、周期更迭等二十好几个独立单元。单看这套分层拼图的思路，确实很符合当下的技术风口。

但真把这套互相调用的逻辑扒开，水实在太深。Zellic团队花了三个月做尽调，直接抓出32个窟窿（其中7个致命、3个高危）。查账机构甚至在报告里明说：没把握扫清所有的雷。要知道，之前OpenZeppelin也爆过它在代理记账、逃避惩罚机制上的死角。在这么庞杂的代码网里，没露面的盲区只怕更吓人。

最让人头皮发麻的是那种“一碰就碎”的连环暴雷。按理说分块是为了把危险隔开，但它的周期和确认部件在底层数据上疯狂“串门”。有时仅仅是发一条修改节点名单的普通指令，就能引发系统级报错，导致全网瞬间停转。就连负责铸造的外围部分，跟外部一接触，发奖数量都有可能被人为篡改。一处小缝隙，直接捅穿整条链的防御。

把一堆极度复杂的共识逻辑全揉在一起，表面看是降维了，实际却把受攻击面无限拉大。代码垒得越高，底部的空洞就越难被发现，这哪是防火墙，简直是把风险强行绑在了一起。

纯属个人随想，非投资建议。这套搭积木的做法你们觉得靠谱吗？评论区扯扯。#eth $ETH

#baby $BABY Weekend, curled up on the couch, and a friend named Dong suddenly tosses over a Babylon security review document: “Have you looked at its underlying architecture? A bunch of core components are all tangled together, and it just feels off.” I casually open up Zellic’s review details, and the deeper I go, the tighter my eyebrows get.

This game of chess is really laid out on a grand scale. It’s all in the name of safeguarding BTC security—staking, IBC cross-chain, state verification, node monitoring, and epoch switching—more than twenty-odd subsystems cobbled together. Just looking at the feature list, the layered “puzzle” makes it sound quite convincing.

But the moment you dig into how these components call each other, the risks can’t be hidden.

The Zellic team spent three months and managed to find 32 bugs: 7 of them critical, 3 high risk. Even the reviewing party included preventive warnings in their own report, explicitly saying they can’t clear every blind spot. What’s more, OpenZeppelin has also had hard issues like delegated ledger misalignment and penalty mechanisms being bypassed. In a code maze where more than twenty systems are wildly interwoven, the undiscovered landmines are absolutely not fewer.

What’s most chilling is the “domino effect” that spreads like a forest fire. Everyone thinks splitting things into smaller pieces can cut off danger, but in Babylon, many components are tightly bound to the underlying data. For example, the epoch management and state verification modules—if someone sends even a seemingly innocuous message to update and verify a node, it could trigger a system crash and bring the entire public chain to a halt. Even the surrounding components responsible for minting have vulnerabilities where, once connected to the outside world, the reward data can be maliciously tampered with.@babylonlabs_io 

Put simply: this project stuffs a whole bunch of extremely complex consensus mechanisms into a single basket. The more interfaces there are, the wider the backdoors available to hackers. On the surface, it breaks down functions, but in practice it strings all the dangers together like dominoes. No matter how fancy the stacked code looks, it can’t cover the gaps in the foundation.

The above is just me making wild guesses—don’t treat it as investment advice. Do you think this architecture is truly isolated, or just a big-sized attack surface? See you in the comments.#eth $ETH

但只要深入琢磨一下这些组件互相调用的逻辑，隐患就盖不住了。

Zellic团队花了三个月，硬是揪出32个bug，其中7个致命级、3个高危。连审查方自己都在报告里打预防针，直言不可能扫清所有死角。何况OpenZeppelin也爆出过委托账本不对齐、惩罚机制被绕过等硬伤。在二十多个系统疯狂穿插的代码网里，没探出来的暗雷绝对只多不少。

最让人捏把汗的是“火烧连营”的连锁反应。大家总以为拆分成小块能切断危险，但在Babylon这里，不少组件在底层数据上是死死绑定的。比如纪元管理和状态确认模块，随便传个更新验证节点的消息，就可能触发系统崩溃，让整条公链直接停摆。就连负责铸造的外围部分，跟外部一通气，奖励数据都有被恶意篡改的漏洞。@babylonlabs_io 

说白了，这项目把一堆极度复杂的共识机制全塞进一个篮子里，接口越多，留给黑客的后门可能就越宽。表面上是拆解了功能，实际却像多米诺骨牌一样把危险全串了起来。堆砌的代码再华丽，也掩饰不住地基里的缝隙。

以上纯属瞎琢磨，大家别当投资参考。你们觉得这架构是真隔离还是大号的攻击面？评论区见。#eth $ETH

事件概述

老铁们应该都看到亚洲盘的惨状了。咱们用大白话讲，就是咱们国内一家有背景的公司搞出了自己的深紫外（DUV）光刻机，直接对标荷兰ASML。这相当于把老美封锁咱们半导体技术的口子给撕开了。

深度解读

为什么这条新闻重要？

说白了，这根本不是什么单纯的技术突破新闻，而是中美科技博弈的拐点信号。西方过去几年靠着ASML卡脖子，现在底层逻辑变了，全球半导体供应链的格局都要重塑。

📰 Iran Threatens to Block the Strait of Hormuz! Can BTC at $63,476 Hold Up?

Event Overview

Iran is stirring things up again. Due to unresolved overseas asset freezes, Iran has directly warned that it will block the Strait of Hormuz. In plain terms—if you don’t return my money, I’ll squeeze the lifeline of global oil shipping.

This isn’t just talk. Nearly 20% of the world’s oil has to pass through this strait. If the blockade were to truly happen, oil prices would rocket, and global risk assets would be hit hard. BTC and ETH have already started moving down as of today: BTC is down to $63,476.94, down 2.31% over 24 hours. ETH is even worse at $1,890.7, down 3.29%.

In-Depth Analysis

Why is This News Important?

Honestly, the Strait of Hormuz has been talked about every few years, but this time is a bit different.

First, the backdrop is more complicated. The situation in the Middle East is tighter now than at the beginning of 2024. Israel hasn’t been calm, and Iran’s patience is basically running out. The asset-freeze issue is, in essence, a messy leftover from the Iran nuclear deal. After the U.S. unilaterally withdrew in 2018, the hundreds of billions of dollars that were frozen for Iran still haven’t been returned. Now Iran is using the strait as leverage to push the West back to the negotiating table.

Second, the timing is extremely delicate. Global markets are already in a high-level range, with the U.S. stock AI bubble debate still not over. The crypto market also hasn’t fully recovered from the pullback earlier this year. When a geopolitical “black swan” hits at a moment like this, capital’s flight-to-safety response can be very intense.

Third, directly related to the crypto market—once risk-off sentiment rises, retail traders run first, and institutions follow by cutting positions. BTC has already fallen below many people’s psychological support levels. If Hormuz truly becomes a problem, traditional markets and crypto could trigger a negative feedback loop.

Impact on the Market

For the short term: once there is any meaningful blockade action in the Strait of Hormuz, oil prices could quickly surge into a three-digit percentage gain range, global equities could plunge, and BTC would likely be dragged down as well. At the $63,476.94 level right now, I don’t think it can hold. Below that, watch the $60,000 round-number support. That area is a dense positioning zone that was repeatedly tested from late last year into early this year—if it breaks, it will be really ugly.

ETH is weaker. $1,890.7 is getting close to the year-to-date low. Altcoin capital is still fleeing to BTC, and the ETH/BTC ratio is continuing to decline. Geopolitical events hit weaker assets harder because liquidity tends to withdraw first from the riskier instruments.

For the medium term, it depends on how much the situation escalates. If it’s just saber-rattling, then after a couple of days the panic should be digested and BTC could rebound. But if there is actual military action or a real, hard blockade—then it’s different. On the day of the Russia–Ukraine conflict in 2022, BTC dropped from around $43,000 directly to $36,000, and it took nearly two months to recover.

Historically, whenever the Middle East situation deteriorates, crypto markets tend to fall first and then rise. Over the long run, geopolitical conflicts actually strengthen the narrative around “non-sovereign assets.” But in the short run, liquidity shocks can’t be ignored—don’t use long-term logic to withstand short-term blows.

If safe-haven money is pouring into Treasuries like crazy, that means the market is truly panicking.

伊朗这边又搞事了。因为海外冻结资产的问题没谈拢，伊朗直接放话要封锁霍尔木兹海峡。说白了就是——你不还我钱，我就把全球石油运输的命脉给掐了。

为什么这条新闻重要？

讲真，霍尔木兹海峡这个事情每隔几年就炒一次，但这次不太一样。

第一，背景更复杂。中东现在的局势比2024年初还要紧张，以色列那边没消停过，伊朗的耐心基本见底了。冻结资产这事说白了就是当年伊核协议遗留的烂账，2018年美国单方面退约之后，伊朗被冻结的几百亿美元一直没拿回来。现在伊朗拿海峡做筹码，是在逼西方回到谈判桌。

先说短期，霍尔木兹海峡一旦有任何实质性的封锁动作，油价可能瞬间飙到三位数涨幅区间，全球股市暴跌，BTC大概率跟着砸。现在$63,476.94这个位置，我觉得守不住。下面看$60,000整数关口，这个位置是去年底到今年初反复测试的密集筹码区，如果破了那就真难看了。

Ethereum, Solana led crypto hack losses in H1 2026: Blockaid

Crypto losses topped $1 billion in the first half of 2026 as the industry recorded its highest number of hacks in a six-month period, according to onchain security platform Blockaid.

Ethereum and Solana recorded the largest losses from incidents affecting their networks, with roughly $332 million and $326 million in stolen funds, respectively, Blockaid said in its H1 2026 security report published Tuesday.

Blockaid tracked 212 security incidents during the period, with the largest single exploit coming from KelpDAO at $292 million, while the platform verified 3.4 times as many high-threshold exploits in H1 2026 as across all of 2025.

Code exploits drove Ethereum incidents, while breaches of keys and signing infrastructure accounted for most Solana losses, according to the report.

Ethereum losses reflected the risks of high-value protocols
Ethereum incurred the highest losses from incidents in H1 2026, with attackers primarily targeting vulnerabilities in applications built on the network.

Blockaid said code exploits dominated Ethereum incidents by count, with major losses also linked to key compromises involving Humanity Protocol and StablR. CoWSwap, an Ethereum-based decentralized exchange, was the only major Ethereum incident in the report classified as a user mistake.
Blockaid identified several common attack methods targeting Ethereum, including bugs in bridges and smart contracts, unauthorized access to privileged accounts and market manipulation techniques.

The report said Ethereum remains a major target because it hosts many of the crypto industry’s most valuable applications, including restaking platforms, stablecoins and decentralized exchanges.

Solana losses surged as attackers shifted focus

translatedData.content:
Today, BTC formed a bearish candle that punched through key levels: it was sold off from 65,090 all the way down to 62,742 before barely managing to stabilize. The closing price is pinned at 63,132, and the slightly bearish setup remains unchanged.

On this leg, ETH has been tracking the drop even more tightly than expected. The daily high at 1,955 couldn’t hold through a single hourly candle; into the late session, it sank straight to around 1,857. The correlation is stronger than independence here—the selloff is even more severe than “big BTC,” extending about another 1 percentage point. Sideways/wing signals are weak.

The most eye-catching mover on today’s gainers list is DEXE: a single green candle pushed it to 3.332, up 35.5%. Trading volume reached 63 million USDT. For its size, that isn’t wildly excessive, but in an environment where the whole market is running low on volume, it clearly looks like local capital concentration. With no real fundamental catalyst, it’s more like capital is hunting for a lifeline in weak conditions—pump it and run.

Some people on the market are taking DEXE’s rally as a sign that small coins are recovering. But that interpretation doesn’t hold up under indicator scrutiny. BTC’s RSI is around 57—nowhere near oversold. The MACD fast and slow lines haven’t finished forming and spreading a death cross, yet price has already been under MA5 for three consecutive hours. Before the MA5 and MA20 “scissor” gap starts to narrow, there was already a divergence move—this is a classic bearish alignment accelerating.

On volume: BTC traded 927 million USDT today, roughly down about one-fifth compared with the average of the last five days. Price falling on shrinking volume is not a “speed-up bottom” signal; it means selling pressure hasn’t been fully released, but there are fewer buyers stepping in. ETH’s RSI has been pushed down to 43. MACD histogram bars turned green, and the death cross has spread from the four-hour timeframe to the daily level. The moving-average structure is now entirely biased bearish.

The key support to watch is 62,742—the session’s intraday low. It’s both today’s dense-trading lower boundary and the prior low area since early June. If this level is ground through on low volume, the next more reliable place to look is around 61,200. Resistance overhead is at 64,200, near the MA5 level—also the second peak formed after this morning’s rebound. If price can’t reclaim that area, it confirms weakness.

Many people think that once DEXE is lifted, it can revive market sentiment. I don’t agree. A coin with trading volume less than a fraction of BTC’s rallying 35% indicates liquidity is extremely crowded and competitive—not a broad shift toward risk-on recovery. If the overall market truly turns strong, we should first see ETH stop falling, not rely on a tiny-cap to set the benchmark.

Tonight, I plan to wait. If BTC around 62,800 tests the lows again with shrinking volume, I’ll watch for a short-term oversold rebound opportunity, but I won’t size in heavily. My stop-loss is set at 62,400. That’s within my personal risk tolerance.

Right now, it’s the same situation as this time last month: drifting lower on declining volume—fewer people can really hold their nerve.

content:
BTC 今天走的是一根穿头破脚的阴线，从 65,090 一路砸到 62,742 才勉强收住，收盘价挂在 63,132，偏空格局没变。

ETH 这轮跟跌跟得比想象中更紧，1,955 的单日高点没撑过一根小时线，尾盘直接沉到 1,857 附近，联动大于独立，跌得比大饼还多出去一个百分点，侧翼信号弱。

今天涨幅榜上最扎眼的是 DEXE，一根阳线拉到 3.332，涨幅 35.5%。成交额干到 6,300 万 USDT，对它的体量来说不算特别夸张，但放在全市场缩量的环境下，明显是存量资金在做局部集中。没什么基本面催化，更多是资金在弱势里找活口，拉了就跑。

市场上有人把 DEXE 拉盘当成小币回暖的信号。但这个说法经不起指标推敲。BTC 的 RSI 在 57 附近，谈不上超卖，MACD 快慢线还没完成死叉扩散，但价格已经连续三个小时躺在 MA5 之下，MA5 和 MA20 的剪刀口在收窄之前先走了一次发散，这是典型的空头排列加速。

成交量方面，BTC 今天 9.27 亿 USDT，比近五日均值缩了大约两成。缩量下跌不是加速见底的信号，它说明抛压还没释放干净，但接盘的人更少。ETH 的 RSI 被打到 43，MACD 柱状体翻绿，死叉从四小时蔓延到日线级别，均线系统已经全线偏空。

关键支撑就看 62,742 这个全天低点。它既是今天的成交密集下沿，也是 6 月初以来的前低区域。如果这里被缩量磨穿，下一个靠得住的位置要看到 61,200 附近。上方阻力在 64,200，MA5 所在的位置，同时也是今天早盘反弹后形成的二次高点，站不回去就是弱势确认。

很多人说 DEXE 拉起来就能带活情绪。我不这么看。一只成交量不到 BTC 零头的币拉 35%，说明流动性极度内卷，而非系统风偏回暖。如果大盘真的转强，应该先看到 ETH 率先止跌，而不是靠一个迷你盘打标杆。

今晚我打算等。如果 BTC 在 62,800 一带再次缩量测试低点，我会留意超跌反弹的短线机会，但仓位不会重，止损挂在 62,400。这是我自己的容错范围。

现在和上个月这个时候一样，缩量阴跌，能管住手的人少。

Lately, many people have started making the same old mistake again:

When they see $ETH  go up, they immediately feel like they’ve missed out; 
{future}(ETHUSDT)
When they notice a knockoff (coin) starts moving, they immediately think a bull market is here.

But I want to remind everyone:

The market is most likely to harvest people when everyone thinks they understand it.

Many traders have a habit:

Chase when it’s rising, panic when it’s falling.

$BTC  moves, and market sentiment follows; if ETH shows a bit more strength, capital starts paying attention; when some popular knockoff coins start pumping, others then go crazy searching for the next opportunity.
{future}(BTCUSDT)
The problem is that opportunities and risks always appear together.

A truly mature trader won’t lose judgment just because prices are going up, and won’t completely lose confidence just because of a pullback.

They focus on three things:

First, look at the trend.
Before the market direction is clearly established, don’t rush into bets. Many losses happen because people enter too early, only to be worn down by volatility.

Second, look at position sizing.
Even if the opportunity is great, you can’t force yourself into a corner with no retreat. Keeping some funds is what gives you the right to face the next market move.

Third, look at sentiment.
When everyone in the market is excited, remind yourself to stay calm; when everyone is panicking, don’t easily get carried away by the crowd’s momentum.

BTC, ETH—plus all kinds of popular knockoff coins—each has its own cycle.

But the ones who truly manage to keep profits aren’t the people who guess correctly every time. It’s those who control losses when they’re wrong, and hold onto opportunities when they’re right.

The market will never give you a better price just because you’re anxious.

Stay calm when the market is crazy, and stay analytical when the market is fearful.

That’s real trading ability.

看到$ETH 上涨，马上觉得踏空；
{future}(ETHUSDT)

但我想提醒一句：

行情最容易收割人的时候，就是所有人都觉得自己看懂的时候。

很多人交易都有一个习惯：

涨的时候追，跌的时候慌。

$BTC 一动，市场情绪跟着变化；ETH稍微强一点，资金开始关注；一些热门山寨出现拉升，又有人开始疯狂寻找下一个机会。
{future}(BTCUSDT)

真正成熟的交易者，不会因为上涨就失去判断，也不会因为回调就彻底失去信心。

他们更关注三个东西：

第一，看趋势。
市场方向没有走出来之前，不急着下注。很多亏损，都是因为太早进场，最后被震荡消耗。

第二，看仓位。
机会再好，也不能把自己逼到没有退路。留有资金，才有资格面对下一次行情。

第三，看情绪。
当市场所有人都兴奋的时候，要提醒自己冷静；当大家恐慌的时候，也不要轻易被带节奏。

BTC、ETH，包括各种热门山寨，都会有属于自己的周期。

但真正能留下利润的人，不是每一次都猜对，而是在错误的时候控制损失，在正确的时候拿住机会。

市场永远不会因为你着急，就给你更好的价格。

行情疯狂时保持冷静，市场恐慌时保持判断。

这才是交易真正的能力。

如果你最近也被行情带乱节奏，可以来找老陈聊聊，交流一下你的交易思路。

Event Overview

To put it plainly, this is one thing: most people in the market are betting that the Fed will hold steady this week, and the futures market is pricing it that way too. But global top-tier market maker Citadel Securities is betting on a rate hike! Even more importantly, Trump is relentlessly pressuring the Fed, and the new chairman, Kevin Warsh, is set to hold his second monetary policy meeting soon.

This isn’t just a rates issue anymore—it’s a hybrid of political maneuvering + high-stakes market gambling. Trading data below shows more and more people are quietly buying protection hedges against the risk of a rate hike; they say they won’t move, but their actions tell the truth.

In-Depth Analysis

Why is this news important?

Guys, the core of this story isn’t the rate hike itself—it’s the word "disagreement."

Most retail investors and institutions are betting on no hike, piling on positions. But what level is Citadel? One of the world’s largest market makers. They’re going against market consensus to bet on a hike—this isn’t gambling; it’s that they have information sources and a decision logic that are completely different from the mainstream. When an institution of this level speaks up, you have to take it seriously.

Even more critical is the undercurrent beneath the surface—traders are already quietly buying protection. On the surface, the headline is "most likely no change," but in reality, the position structure is tilting toward a hike. Simply put, smart money is preparing for the worst-case scenario—it just hasn’t said so out loud.

Trump pressuring the Fed is even more troublesome. As a new chairman, Warsh is being pulled into political forces for his second decision—no matter whether rates ultimately rise or not, market confidence will be damaged. If the Fed’s independence gets called into question, then every future policy meeting will become a game of guessing the political winds. That’s a time bomb for all risk assets.

Currently, BTC is already down 2.31% at $63,476.94, and ETH is even worse—crashing to $1,890.7 down 3.29%. The market has already voted with its feet.

Impact on the Market

In the short term, this is an emotional trigger point.

If there is truly a rate hike, BTC would likely break straight through $63,000 to find support lower down. The $60,000 round-number level is the first line of defense—once it breaks, things won’t look good. ETH is already at $1,890.7; if it pushes lower, $1,850 is the key support. But even if there’s no hike, as long as the wording is more hawkish, or Warsh doesn’t sound dovish enough in the press conference, the market will still get spooked. Institutional allocation to crypto assets depends on the fiat system’s rules being predictable. Once those rules can be changed by individual will, the pace at which traditional capital enters the market will slow down noticeably. That’s far more serious than whether the rate is hiked.

For historical reference: every time the Fed tightens more than expected, the crypto market tends to drop the hardest. When liquidity tightens, high-volatility assets get hit like a nuclear blast.

老铁们，这条新闻的核心不在加息本身，在于"分歧"两个字。

One sentence to make it clear:
OPEC+ announced that after September they will pause expanding production. The Iran conflict could send oil prices rocketing at any moment, and BTC and ETH face greater selling pressure.

What’s going on
Guys, OPEC+ has a very loud set of fine-calculated plans. The market previously expected them to gradually restore output after September, but now they just call a stop. The reason is plain: four words— the Iran conflict. The atmosphere in the Middle East is getting more combustible by the day. OPEC+ knows full well that if they still dare to increase production and a genuine supply disruption happens, oil prices will literally launch into the sky. So they choose to play it safe and hold the production line for now.

This move is basically adding insurance to the global energy market, but the price is that inflation expectations will rise again. Right now BTC is at $63,525.99, down 2.31% over the past 24 hours. ETH is even worse: $1,890.26, down 3.35%. Signs of capital running for the exits are already very obvious.

Impact on the market
In the short term, the expectation of a surge in oil prices will directly transmit to risk-asset markets. The logic from Wall Street institutions is especially simple and blunt: oil prices rise → inflation expectations increase → rate cuts are out of the question → sell first to escape overvalued assets. BTC and ETH, as the leading “risk assets,” get smashed first.

The mid-term impact is even more worrying. If the situation in Iran keeps deteriorating, global capital will accelerate its shift into traditional safe havens like gold and U.S. Treasuries. Although the crypto market has a long-term narrative of “digital gold,” in the short run institutions still treat it like a high-risk tech stock—and they won’t indulge you.

Honestly, at this point I don’t recommend rushing to bottom-fish. If BTC breaks and holds below $63,525.99—the integer support—downside room opens up immediately. ETH breaking below $1,890.26 is showing even clearer weakness, so don’t catch a falling knife.

Is keeping interest rates stable a done deal? Don’t overlook the rate-hike topic—hidden market variables may be at play

Early Thursday morning, the Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision is set to be released. Since last December, rates have been held steadily at 3.75%. This will be the fifth consecutive time that the central bank keeps rates unchanged. The market generally expects that this meeting will also maintain rates as is.

Many people mistakenly believe that holding rates unchanged will mean everything will be calm and steady—this is a major misconception. Inflation is still prone to recurring. The idea of restarting rate hikes has already been brought back to the negotiating table many times. Even if there is no direct rate hike this time, remarks from Fed officials—especially those like Waller’s—will most likely adopt a hawkish tone, while keeping open the option for further rate hikes.

If the wording is hawkish and suggests that a restart of rate hikes is not ruled out, the U.S. dollar will strengthen. Risk assets would face pressure, and BTC and ETH are likely to see a wave of profit-taking and a pullback

If the wording is more moderate and continues to confirm that the pause in the hiking cycle will remain, then safe-haven capital will keep flowing into the crypto market, helping drive a recovery for the long side.

 At this stage, price action will shift into expectation-driven games ahead of the news, volatility will intensify, and spike-and-wick price moves will become the norm. Don’t go heavy on one-way bets. Before the news is released, don’t blindly chase gains or sell in panic. Gulf states endorse Iran’s paid toll plan! Will BTC at $63,495 keep falling?

💡 Bearish! Geopolitical tensions + rising oil-price inflation expectations boost risk-off sentiment, prompting funds to retreat.

BTC is down 2.36% over 24 hours to $63,495.99. ETH is even worse, down 3.58% to $1,879.31, and the broader market is still bleeding.

One sentence to explain it
Gulf states support Iran collecting tolls in the Strait of Hormuz, which could choke global energy shipping—hurting the crypto market right along with it.

What’s going on
In plain terms, Iran wants to set up a “voluntary payment” mechanism in the Strait of Hormuz—a chokepoint through which about one-third of the world’s seaborne oil shipments pass. What’s really telling is that the Gulf states have even endorsed it. These oil producers want to band together and squeeze out more money. If this actually gets implemented, oil transportation costs will rise, and oil prices will likely surge. When oil prices climb, inflation data will look worse again, making Fed rate cuts even less likely. Plus, such a move could undermine the dollar’s dominance in oil trade and accelerate “de-dollarization.”

Market impact
In the short term, geopolitical tensions layered with inflation fears will send money rushing into safe assets, with risk assets taking the hit first. High-volatility assets like BTC and ETH will inevitably see institutions cut positions to de-risk. You can already see it today: BTC has broken below 64,000, and ETH is nearing the 1,800 support line.

Over the medium term, things get even trickier. As Gulf states move closer to Iran, it signals that the Middle East landscape is shifting. If inflation re-accelerates due to oil prices, this year’s rate-cut expectations are basically gone. Tightening liquidity would be a direct blow to the entire crypto market. “De-dollarization” sounds good for Bitcoin, but the near-term macro pressure is far greater than the narrative upside.

My take
Honestly, I wouldn’t try to catch a falling knife at this level. On the bearish side, BTC will likely probe lower, with support first at the 60,000 even level. ETH is weaker—1,800 might not hold. Don’t rush to bottom-fish now; wait for concrete signals of easing from the Persian Gulf.

The hardest thing to beat in trading is actually yourself
After entering the crypto market, many people spend a lot of time searching for the “most accurate” indicators and the “strongest” strategies.
But the longer I trade, the more I feel that the real factor affecting results isn’t which indicators you use—it’s whether you can stick to your own trading rules.
When prices are rising, you fear missing the entry and can’t help chasing higher; when prices fall, you’re reluctant to cut losses and hope the market will reverse; during range-bound periods, you frequently open and close positions, and in the end both fees and emotions drain you.
I believe many traders have experienced these problems.
And that’s also why more and more people are turning their attention to quantitative trading.
Quantitative trading isn’t about predicting the market—it’s about handing your trading rules over to a program to execute, so that opening positions, take-profit, stop-loss, and position management all run according to a predefined logic, minimizing the impact of emotions as much as possible.
Recently, after learning about CubeQuants (魔方量化), I found myself quite aligned with one of its ideas: rather than constantly guessing what the next candlestick will be, build a trading system that can be executed consistently over the long term.
The market changes every day, but trading discipline shouldn’t change with your emotions.
Of course, no strategy can adapt to every market condition, and there is no trading system that guarantees 100% profitability. But for long-term trading, stable execution, reasonable risk control, and ongoing optimization are often more valuable than chasing high returns in the short term.
What’s the biggest challenge for you during trading? Is it judging the market, managing position size, or overcoming your own emotions? Feel free to discuss with me.

In normal lending markets, liquidation trigger lines are fixed: when the price drops to a certain level, everyone rushes in to buy the dip. But this project's wording is extremely vague. It only mentions one line: “When the BTC price falls below the safety threshold,” and then starts the liquidation. So the question is: when facing some extremely extreme “heaven-and-earth needle” market conditions, can liquidators simply take action because the rules are unclear?

This is exactly like the playbook from the 2008 financial crisis, when banks seized properties—scrutinizing contract language, and retail investors get forcibly liquidated directly amid the panic of a crash. They don’t even get the chance to hold on and wait for a rebound.

Even more devastating is the design in Part 10 of the documentation. The system parameters are apparently decided by token-holder votes from $BABY . Don’t think too hard—liquidation standards and response times are definitely within the scope of what can be voted on. This is a perfect harvesting-and-death-spiral loop: those liquidation whales are often also heavy holders of $BABY . They can coordinate and do harm by suddenly pushing proposals to raise the “original” 120% red line all the way up to 150%. They can use the rules they changed to seize other people’s collateral, profit handsomely, and then go to the secondary market to accumulate more $BABY—continuously expanding their influence. This doesn’t even require external hacker attacks; the system’s own mechanism is effectively encouraging whales to misbehave.

Don’t forget: this stablecoin is supposed to circulate across the whole network through cross-chain bridges. Once it gets embedded in all kinds of protocols and keeps nesting to earn yield, one day some deep-pocket whale suddenly changes the underlying parameters. That will trigger a chain reaction stampede, and every downstream pool will be dragged down to die with it. We all complain that USDT reserves aren’t transparent, and we think only things backed purely by BTC are more trustworthy.
